format_notice: R7 original research display examples, not an accepted product/native schema, canonical evidence store or decision plane. Mapping belongs to existing identity/evidence/theme/F04 owners.
consumer_goal: Existing Themes dossier -> economic role/geography/cash explanation -> original source -> unchanged existing stock workflow.

records.subject: Vulcan / aggregates
records.proposed_display: Comparable selling-price gains exceeded the stated cash-cost increase by a much smaller amount.
records.source_reported_summary: Reported freight-adjusted price and cash-cost series support the unit-contribution reconciliation.
records.research_interpretation: Inspect what the business retained after comparable costs rather than treating price growth as equal margin growth.
limitations: Cash gross profit is not FCF.
Displayed tonnes and totals retain small ratio residuals.
Diesel attribution is management explanation, not an automatic permanent addback.
records.next_evidence: Next comparable same-scope price, cost, volume and cash-capital observation.
forbidden_inference: Do not rank all local producers from one issuer average.
Do not treat freight-adjusted realization as a complete route-cost model.

records.subject: Martin Marietta / aggregate price and mix
records.proposed_display: Reported average price declined while organic and mix-adjusted price measures improved.
records.reference_period: Q2 2026; H1 cash is a separate period
records.research_interpretation: A changed sales population can reverse a blended price signal; display the populations rather than averaging the signs.
limitations: Organic methods are issuer-defined.
Single purchase-accounting adjustment is not organic or normalized earnings.
records.next_evidence: Comparable regional/product realization, volume, costs and acquired-asset integration cash.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer lost local pricing power from reported average alone.
Do not annualize H1 cash or relabel divestiture-related tax as recurring operating deterioration.

records.subject: Heidelberg / replacement project and cash
records.proposed_display: A productive replacement thesis still has a seasonal working-capital and investment requirement.
records.source_reported_summary: Continuing and discontinued operating cash are separately reported; investment and grants have their own cash categories.
records.research_interpretation: Show the source-to-cash bridge and distinguish expected project savings from proven recurring results.
limitations: The selected residual is not issuer-defined FCF.
A 0.1m displayed bridge difference is retained.
Airvault savings remain management expectations.
records.next_evidence: Actual replacement output, retired capacity, comparable input intensity, downstream constraints and cash conversion.
forbidden_inference: Do not count replacement gross capacity as full net growth.
Do not count capital grants twice.

records.subject: Weyerhaeuser / operating cash, land and FAD
records.proposed_display: The distribution metric excludes specified growth spending; land-sale proceeds and earnings are different amounts.
records.reference_period: Q2 2026; H1 shown only in separate reconciliation
records.source_reported_summary: Q2 operating cash less all capex is 260m USD; adjusted FAD is 323m after the specified 63m adjustment.
records.research_interpretation: Preserve the investment purpose without pretending the cash was never spent, and distinguish asset monetization from recurring harvest/manufacturing economics.
limitations: Not a property valuation or forestry recommendation.
Future land/harvest rights cannot remain unchanged after their sale.
records.next_evidence: Growth-project returns, remaining asset economics, renewal spending and recurring cash after the land transaction.
forbidden_inference: Do not add sale proceeds to unchanged perpetual harvest cash.
Do not substitute a sale gain for sale cash.

records.subject: West Fraser / Henderson replacement ramp
records.proposed_display: Sequential ramp progress reached the former mill's output, not proof that the full new capacity is incremental.
records.source_reported_summary: The company describes Henderson as a replacement and distinguishes other curtailments and restarts.
records.research_interpretation: Measure gross new, retired and net useful capacity separately and test reliability/cost benefits.
limitations: Complete source-reconciled FCF is unavailable in this selected evidence set.
No new market-balance calculation.
records.next_evidence: Net saleable output, cost and customer acceptance versus the retired asset; remaining investment.
forbidden_inference: Do not count a replaced mill twice.
Do not infer FCF solely from earnings and one operating-cash figure.

records.subject: Suzano / cash-generation definitions
records.proposed_display: Several cash measures describe different accounting perimeters; the labels are not interchangeable.
records.source_reported_summary: The issuer's operating cash generation begins with adjusted EBITDA and deducts sustaining capex.
records.research_interpretation: Present each definition and its renewal, financing and distribution treatment before any cross-company comparison.
limitations: Selected original SEC table text was recovered; referenced slide images were not.
The FCF bridge preserves a 1m displayed residual.
Cash-statement and issuer-adjusted residuals are not a harmonized FCF.
records.next_evidence: Original image/full-report confirmation where required and a source-complete cash-versus-accrual investment mapping.
forbidden_inference: Do not call EBITDA-minus-sustaining-capex primary-statement CFO.
Do not turn changed segment allocation into physical efficiency.

records.subject: Mondi / biological marks and operating cash
records.proposed_display: Excluding only forestry valuation marks narrows the earnings decline but does not establish normalized cash.
records.source_reported_summary: The current forestry mark is a loss and the prior mark is a gain; cash investment is separately reported.
records.research_interpretation: Explain noncash valuation, operating performance and asset renewal together without treating an addback as spendable cash.
limitations: Cash statement was visually checked.
Detailed forestry asset rollforward image remains unavailable and is not numerically admitted.
records.next_evidence: Comparable biological assumptions, cash harvest/renewal and subsequent mill/converter performance.
forbidden_inference: Do not ignore economic information in a noncash valuation change.
Do not present the selected post-interest/lease residual as an issuer FCF definition.

records.subject: PCA / legacy versus acquired corrugated growth
records.proposed_display: Strong total shipment growth and legacy business performance need separate explanations.
records.source_reported_summary: Total shipments increased 24.3% while legacy shipments increased 4.1%; the adjusted EPS bridge includes opposing legacy/acquired effects.
records.research_interpretation: Separate population changes from retained legacy economics and subsequent returns on acquisition capital.
limitations: Adjusted EPS is issuer-defined.
Comparison with company guidance is not analyst consensus.
A full FCF bridge is not admitted from the selected release.
records.next_evidence: Same-population realization, unit/area mix, capital and working-capital performance after integration.
forbidden_inference: Do not call total acquired growth organic demand.
Do not treat package area as tonnes without a specification.

records.subject: Amcor / reimbursement, acquisition and cash seasonality
records.proposed_display: Acquired revenue and raw-material reimbursement explain most of the reported increase; Q4 cash must not be annualized.
records.reference_period: FY2026 and Q4 ended June 30; periods explicitly separate
records.source_reported_summary: Named Q4 FCF exceeds the full-year amount; adjusted FCF excludes specified integration/transaction costs.
records.research_interpretation: Show actual capital/integration cash and compare comparable demand rather than extrapolating the strongest quarter.
limitations: The 74m sales bridge residual is not pure volume.
A 1m statement-versus-named-FCF difference is unassigned.
Combined-company growth methods and share basis retain their source definition.
records.next_evidence: Matched organic/combined-population demand, actual reimbursement lag, working-capital normalization and integration returns.
forbidden_inference: Do not annualize Q4 FCF.
Do not remove real investment cash simply because it is labeled integration.

records.subject: AF&PA / industry capacity and mixed observation clocks
records.proposed_display: Operating-rate, production and trade observations describe different denominators and periods.
records.reference_period: Containerboard Q1/Q2 2026; printing/writing August shipments versus July trade
records.source_reported_summary: Public releases distinguish output, capacity, domestic demand, exports and differently dated trade observations.
records.research_interpretation: Explain rationalization separately from demand growth and withhold an unsupported same-month balance.
limitations: Public summaries only; paid tables were not obtained.
A ratio increase is not independent physical output.
records.next_evidence: Same-period grade-specific production, capacity, inventory and trade with lawful source coverage.
forbidden_inference: Do not combine August shipments and July imports into an August balance.
Do not infer rising physical demand from utilization alone.

records.subject: Anhui Conch / China quantitative coverage gap
records.proposed_display: A China-specific comparison is not yet quantitatively admitted from this evidence set.
records.reference_period: H1 2026; mirror lists September 9, not verified first publication
records.source_reported_summary: Original-author report text distinguishes self-produced and trading activities; required table images were not recovered.
records.research_interpretation: Use the text to identify the next source questions, not as an accepted cross-region numerical model.
limitations: Relevant PDF table screenshots failed.
No verified first-publication timestamp for all report facts.
One issuer cannot represent the entire Chinese market.
records.next_evidence: Recover original exchange/issuer report and required page images, then reconcile self-produced/trading, region and accounting scopes.
forbidden_inference: Do not publish table-derived China margins or cash comparisons from this case.
Do not import U.S. aggregate pricing behavior into China by analogy.
